title: 10 Tribes Vanished. Where Did They Go?
author: QUILL
notes: Modern descent claims framed as claims. Sargon II 'about 27,000'. Not-proven line in beat 9. British Israelism shown only as a claim.

beats.text: Ten tribes of Israel vanished from history.
Assyria's Sargon II boasts of deporting about 27,000 people.
beats.say: Assyria's SAR-gon the Second boasts of deporting about twenty-seven thousand people.

beats.text: So where did they go? Three modern claims, and the last is the strangest.
Second Kings says Halah, the Habor river in Gozan, and the cities of the Medes.
beats.say: Second Kings says HAY-lah, the HAY-bor river in GO-zan, and the cities of the MEEDS.

beats.text: But some northerners stayed. Hezekiah later invited them to Passover.
beats.say: But some northerners stayed. Hez-eh-KY-ah later invited them to Passover.
beats.label: SOME STAYED

beats.text: Claim one: India's Bnei Menashe say they descend from Manasseh.
beats.say: Claim one: India's BNAY men-NAH-sheh say they descend from Manasseh.

beats.text: Two: some Pashtun traditions claim Israelite roots, but most scholars doubt it.
beats.say: Two: some PUSH-toon traditions claim Israelite roots, but most scholars doubt it.

beats.text: Three, the strangest: British Israelism says the British descend from them.
beats.label: CLAIM ONLY

beats.text: Not proven: no modern group is shown to descend from them.
From Samaria to Media, the written trail goes cold.
beats.say: From Suh-MARE-ee-uh to MEE-dee-uh, the written trail goes cold.

beats.text: Ten tribes vanished from history. Lost in Assyria, or alive today?

youtube.title: 10 Tribes Vanished. Where Did They Go? 🗺️ #shorts
youtube.description:
Assyria deported Israelites from Samaria around 722 BC, and then the record goes quiet. Three modern claims say they found them.
No modern group has been shown to descend from the ten tribes. Claims are shown as claims.
#LostTribes #BibleHistory #Archaeology #MythUnearthed
